hints.push: Step forward to a newer record. If already at the newest, opens a blank page — type anything to create a new record.
hints.pull: Step back to an older record. If on a blank page with text, saves it first before moving.
hints.commit: Upload ALL records from the selected branch to the cloud, replacing the entire cloud copy. Last write wins — your version overwrites whatever was there. File attachments included. File upload failure does not block text; failed files retry on next commit.
hints.checkout: Re-download the selected branch from the cloud, overwriting your local copy.
hints.switch: Change to a different branch. If it only exists on the cloud, it's downloaded first.
hints.fork: Duplicate every record from the selected branch into a new unnamed branch. The original and copy are fully separate — edits to one never affect the other.
hints.dropClean: Erase all records in this branch but keep the branch itself. One blank placeholder remains.
hints.dropDrop: Delete the cloud copy of this branch. Local records stay untouched.
hints.dropDelete: Permanently remove this empty branch from your device. Cannot be undone.
hints.themeToggle: Toggle dark/light theme. Requires the Light Theme MOD.
hints.shelfHandle: Extension panel grip. Drag left to expand, right to shrink. Double-click to close.
hints.wipeLocal: Nuke all local IndexedDB (BB branches, WT records, BC channels, file_blobs). Server untouched. Page reloads. Two-step confirm.
hints.dropAllBranches: DELETE all your BB branches on the server. Login required. Local data untouched. Two-step confirm.

wt.theyPush: View a newer record on your partner's board (read-only).
wt.theyPull: View an older record on your partner's board (read-only).
wt.wePush: Step forward to a newer record on your board. Partner sees whisper preview (~20ms); full commit to server ~2s after you stop typing. At the newest, opens a blank page for a new message.
wt.wePull: Step back to an older record on your board. Current text is saved first. Partner sees the head shift in real-time.
wt.add: Connect with another user by UID. Both sides get a paired board — you write on yours, they write on theirs, visible to each other via whisper (~20ms).
wt.cut: Disconnect the selected partner and erase all message history for this pair on both sides.

bc.pin: Bookmark this channel. Pinned channels appear at the top of your list.
bc.cast: Publish ALL local records to this channel, replacing its entire cloud content. Full upload, not just the current record. File upload failure does not block text; failed files retry on next cast.
bc.create: Start a new local channel. Write records first, then CAST to publish.
bc.delete: Permanently destroy this channel and all its records (local + cloud). Owner only. Cannot be undone.

mods.refresh: Re-scan all MOD templates and check availability.

config.maxSlot: Max records per branch. Oldest auto-removed when full.
config.autoCleanBlanks: Auto-remove blank records when navigating. Keeps history clean.
config.updateTimestamp: Move edited record to newest position. OFF = stays in place.
config.autoSync: Two-way sync for the CURRENT branch only: auto-commit 2s after idle, remote changes appear in ~4s via WS/poll. Other branches sync when you switch to them. Requires login.
config.loopList: Wrap around: past the last item → first, and vice versa.
config.boardSwap: Your board on top, partner below. OFF = partner on top (default).
config.screensaverTimeout: Seconds after leaving the tab before screensaver activates. Max value disables it.
config.crtBlendMode: Full CRT scanlines. OFF = scanlines blend with content and fade on text.

llm.button: Send current text to AI. Output appears in the panel below.
llm.provider: Where AI runs — client: browser (offline, private). server: local Ollama. apikey: cloud API (needs key).
llm.clientModel: Browser-local AI model via WebGPU. Larger = smarter but needs more VRAM.
llm.apiModel: Model ID from your cloud provider (e.g. gpt-4o-mini).
llm.apiKey: Your API key. Stored in browser only — never sent to our server.

llmBb.button: Feed records to AI for analysis (summarize, extract, transform).
llmBb.target: Scope: current branch records, branch list, or all branches combined.

llmBc.button: Feed channel content to AI for analysis.
llmBc.target: Scope: current record only, or all records in the channel.

translate.button: Translate current text to your target language. Result in panel below.

stt.button: Record from microphone. Speech converted to text and inserted into the editor.

markdownPreview.button: Render current text as formatted Markdown in the panel below.

aa.matrixRain: Matrix-style falling characters on the screensaver. Pure decoration.
aa.perlinBg: Flowing noise texture behind content. Subtle atmosphere.
aa.mouseLight: Cursor glow — like a flashlight on the CRT screen.
aa.toastAnim: Spinner animation on notifications and text panels while operations are in progress.

mods.configDefault: Select a MOD from the list.
mods.catalogPreview: Add this MOD to start configuring.
